grading.A: peer-reviewed or traceable scientific dataset; explicit analyte; same MQ model(s) as HR069; known concentration and/or raw numeric response suitable for fingerprint construction

grading.C: different MQ/TGS sensor models or non-analyte source classes; useful for transfer, preprocessing, drift, protocol or feature engineering only
